nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
To judge the appearance of the sky.
The outer correspondence is about signs. The second correspondence is about judging the appearance of the sky. The latter half is criticism against behaviors of the Pharisees described in the former part. The heaven and the sky is same word in Greek (Greek{ou)rano/j})
